title: CP/M-386 – CP/M for 386 protected mode, derived from CP/M‑68K
summary: CP/M-386 is a project that ports the classic CP/M operating system to Intel 386 processors running in protected mode, derived from the existing CP/M-68K implementation. It enables running legacy CP/M applications on modern x86 hardware.
problem_solved: Enables legacy CP/M software to run on Intel 386 processors in protected mode, preserving vintage computing software.
why_valuable: Provides software preservation and retrocomputing capabilities by bringing CP/M compatibility to modern x86 systems, serving the vintage computing community.
